correctness.rationale: For bi-infinite periodic nonconstant binary words, run differentiation gives a primitive circular derivative. A primitive inverse alternates two symbols and uses one run-length period for even derivative period or two for odd; the inverse least period equals the corresponding sum. Every X1 primitive derivative avoids cyclic 111/222, forcing at least one symbol 2 per three positions, so inverse length grows at least 4/3. Any depth-ten period <=269 descends nine steps to an X1 primitive period <=floor(269(3/4)^9)=20. I independently enumerated all primitive oriented binary necklaces without cyclic triples at length 2..20 and expanded every retained inverse orientation, pruning only lengths>269; 2170 seeds, level counts [2170,3474,5632,9073,11218,5590,2666,300,32,16], least period counts [(2,1),(3,2),(8,1),(12,2),(18,4),(27,8),(80,4),(120,8),(180,16),(269,16)]. This reproduces the exact first-ten table with a genuinely exhaustive finite cutoff for each claimed depth, not an inference that any infinite-depth word is periodic. The proof's distinct rotation/complement handling is necessary and present.
